**Convergence pass 7/10 — receipt · new winner: YES**

**Winner: XS-17 + XS-18 + XS-19** — retire the deprecated-tool residue for `ntfy` (dschep/ntfy) and `tabby`. Both are `_deprecated` in `software.yml` (tabby: "Deprecated in favor of Warp terminal"; ntfy: "Compatibility tombstone"), so installx filters them from any fresh host — yet their chezmoi config/symlink sources and the post-tabby `npm install` hook still shipped to every machine, causing deploy-then-self-delete churn plus a fleet-wide plugin hook for an app that never installs.

**Changes:**
- Deleted 7 tracked files: `home/dot_config/ntfy/private_ntfy.yml.tmpl`, `home/Library/Application Support/ntfy/symlink_ntfy.yml.tmpl`, `home/dot_config/tabby/{plugins/package.json,private_config.yaml.tmpl}`, `home/Library/Application Support/tabby/{symlink_config.yaml.tmpl,symlink_plugins.tmpl}`, `home/dot_local/bin/post-installx/executable_post-tabby.sh`.
- `home/dot_config/shell/exports.sh.tmpl`: removed the dead `### ntfy` / `AUTO_NTFY_DONE_IGNORE` export.
- Added `scripts/test-deprecated-tool-residue.sh` (7 assertions, auto-discovered by `test-all.sh`'s `test-*.sh` glob): residue absent · env var removed · catalog tombstones preserved · dispatcher wazuh example intact · no dangling `script:` dispatch · non-vacuous self-test.

**Evidence (verified, not assumed):**
- `git grep` for all 7 paths + `AUTO_NTFY_DONE_IGNORE` + `post-tabby` across `home/` `scripts/` → zero functional references outside the deleted files themselves (the only hit was `test-post-installx-dispatch.sh`'s A8 *doc comment*). No `software.yml` `script:` entry dispatched either hook; no `.chezmoiscripts` reference.
- `software.yml` still carries `ntfy:` (L12680) and `tabby:` (L10706) as `_deprecated` tombstones — source of truth preserved, only residue removed.
- `executable_post-ntfy.sh` was already deleted in the prior wave-two worktree (pre-existing, untouched by this pass).

**Tests run:**
- `bash scripts/test-deprecated-tool-residue.sh` → **7/7 PASS** (incl. self-test) · `bash -n` clean · `shellcheck` clean.
- `test-post-installx-dispatch.sh` → **13/13** (dispatcher now 39/39 hooks, post-tabby dropped cleanly) · `test-templates.sh` → **3/3** (222 templates balanced, chezmoi sampled 50) · `test-external-integrity.sh` → **2/2** · `test-catalog-wave-two-cleanup.sh` → **4/4** · `test-no-removed-tools.sh` → **17/17**.

**Risks:**
- Low. Source-only removal; no app uninstalled, no service stopped, no secret/user data touched. A user who manually installed Tabby/ntfy outside the catalog keeps the app — they lose only the repo-supplied config on next `chezmoi apply`. Residual inert references (`tabby.desktop` in `home/dot_config/desktop/gnome.yml` dock favorites, legacy `home/dot_local/share/ansible/environments/prod/...` tree) intentionally left untouched as unrelated edits.

**New winner implemented:** Yes.
